He's been running his steamed bun stall here for eight years, quietly watching people come and go. Some stop by today, others tomorrow, and some just don't come back. 
The young customer who, two years ago, boasted about making a name for himself in Kaifeng City had now returned—quiet, worn out, and dressed in rags. 
Another regular customer who, three years ago, used to rave about his amazing Scallion Pancakes had now strolled through town dressed in silk, bragging about the fancy food in Kaifeng's restaurants. 
People change. So do their hearts. But steamed buns, pancakes, and fried dough? They stay the same. 
And his reckless brother? He hasn't changed a bit—still causing trouble all over the place and getting into fights every day.
